secondCard.bioText: A storyteller with a camera — I document cultural events from the inside, not from afar. I've worked with theater troupes and art centers for eight years, and I love to deliver the image while it's still hot.

review.reviewText: Karim arrived ahead of time and set up the lighting on his own — the material was delivered in two days instead of a week, and with quality exceeding what was agreed upon.
Clean work and complete commitment to the agreement. Communication could have been a bit faster at the beginning, but the delivery made up for everything.

review.exchangeText: After sponsoring the service "Personal Photoshoot Session" ·
review.reviewText: He made the session easy and light, and the photos came out natural — first time I feel the camera isn't frowning at me.
